episode_title: Children speak at father's sentencing. Business partner on trial for double murder. Plus, manhunts.

real_qa.q: What was the verdict in the Maya Miliete murder case after trial in 2024?
real_qa.r: In July, the jury found Larry Miliete guilty of first degree murder of his wife Maya. This came more than five years after Maya's disappearance in January 2021 from their Chula Vista home, where her body has never been found.

real_qa.q: Why did Larry Miliete purchase spells from an online spellcaster according to prosecution testimony?
real_qa.r: The prosecution called an online spellcaster as a witness who testified that Larry was purchasing spells. The requests ranged from trying to get Maya to not leave him to her falling in love with him again, but then escalated to requests asking for Maya to suffer from an accident and have a broken bone.

real_qa.q: What sentence did Larry Miliete receive for the murder of his wife Maya?
real_qa.r: Larry Miliete was sentenced to 25 years to life in prison for the murder, plus an additional two years for a gun charge he pleaded guilty to after trial, effectively 27 to life. The judge also instituted a 10-year protective order restricting Larry's contact with his children.

real_qa.q: What evidence did prosecutors present that Andrew Griffin traveled to Ohio to commit the Strushan murders?
real_qa.r: Prosecutors say they discovered Griffin had given money to Brett Cole to pick up a motorcycle a few weeks before the murders. Highway plate reader cameras captured that motorcycle heading toward Ohio right before the murders took place, and a burner phone connected to Griffin pinged off cell towers close to the Stretchen home on the day of the murders.
real_qa.requete: Andrew Griffin motorcycle burner phone Strushan murders

real_qa.q: What was Andrew Griffin's financial motive for allegedly murdering Tom and Angela Strushan?
real_qa.r: Griffin had invested more than $100,000 in Salsa Joe's restaurant starting in January 2021. By August 2021, Tom told Griffin he was done with the business because it was not profitable, with no discussion of Griffin getting his investment back. Griffin was then locked out of the shared bank account where he had been investing money.
